rule: Proposed readings of the 28 spellings. Not confirmed.
One row per location. Blank criticality kept and flagged. Prefix and body are text labels only. No parent links inferred.
One row per material, after confirming attributes never differ. Comparisons are raw, with no status label. Descriptions shared across codes are flagged, never merged.
One row per supplier code, after confirming one name and one currency per code. No amounts or rankings. Non-IDR currency is not treated as proof of a foreign supplier.
One row per location and material pair. Exact copies are represented by all_source_rows and occurrence_count. Installed Qty is identical across copies.
One row per order and notification, from notifications with an order. No allocation rule is applied to shared orders.
All source rows kept. in_exact_distinct_rows selects the sensitivity view. Population-based flags are held per view. No unit amount is derived (DEF-05).
All source rows kept. No duplicate policy is applied (A-05). Location is filled only when the order leads to exactly one location. Shared orders stay ambiguous and are never allocated.
All source rows kept. Blank completion dates and orders are never filled. Open records are censored at the assumed cutoff (A-01). Notifications are not treated as failures (DEF-09). No priority rank.
All source rows kept. Interval columns are proposed readings that need DEF-10. Future starts use the single cutoff. No due dates are projected (DEF-11).
